identifier_checks.method: Globally unique random 80-bit hex tokens; primary-key uniqueness per table; reject a numeric substring of 3+ digits incrementing by one across 4 consecutive rows. Random individual digit runs are not ordinal counters. All tables are independently shuffled.

single_signal_checks.interpretation: Range overlap requires at least 50% of each class within the common observed range. Perfect threshold tests operate in either direction, with ties not separating. Category tests also reject any exclusive category. These marginal checks do not establish distributional equality or eliminate all generator artifacts.

limitations: Observable behavioral patterns support competing hypotheses; latent person ownership cannot be proven from device equality.
Appeal assertions have event-level witnesses, but appeal quality and wording still contain possible synthetic artifacts.
Cycle timestamps use half-open intervals. Endpoints of open cycles are the sole post-window timestamp exception.

legacy_source_check.method: Compare AST hashes against the saved v1 source; remove only the new fact-collector call from add_appeals before comparing. This verifies original branch structure, call order, arguments, templates and suffix draws.

distinct_sentences.normalization: Split on runs of period/exclamation/question mark; lowercase; mask ISO dates as <date>; collapse whitespace. Unpunctuated appeal is one sentence.

unpunctuated_sentence_unit_sensitivity.method: Additionally split double spaces used for unpunctuated sentence units.

sentence_lookup.method: Leave one out; one vote per distinct matching training appeal; ties use training majority then lexical kind order; unmatched appeals abstain, with training-majority fallback also reported.

word_pair_classifier.method: Leave-one-out multinomial naive Bayes; alpha=1; training-fold vocabulary; lowercase ASCII words; ISO dates masked; adjacent word bigram counts; unseen features ignored; honest wins exact ties.

uniform_prior_sensitivity.method: Leave-one-out multinomial naive Bayes; alpha=1; training-fold vocabulary; lowercase ASCII words; ISO dates masked; adjacent word bigram counts; unseen features ignored; honest wins exact ties.

distributions_per_kind.claim_type_count_scope: Independently sampled claim topics realized as assertions, qualified statements, or questions. Unobserved family, household, roommate, coworker, project-purpose and access-loss facts are not invented for honest appeals. Topic counts do not claim every mention is a factual assertion.
distributions_per_kind.style_sampling: One unconditional register/length/quality/sample draw sequence per appeal from random.Random(SEED + 1); no kind input, rejection sampling, balancing, or resampling. Cards were frozen before prose authoring.

style_card_realization.sentence_units: Punctuated prose uses .!? boundaries. For no-punctuation cards, two spaces separate the individually authored sentence units; dates retain permitted ISO hyphens. The sentence leakage audit still treats each whole unpunctuated body as one sentence.
style_card_realization.qualitative_review: Registers and intended typos were checked by the author against frozen cards; these are editorial judgments, not automatic linguistic certifications.

identity_check.method: Run original event and legacy appeal generation unchanged, reproduce the original full-file SHA-256, then recursively compare every field and ordered row against v2 and compare serialized protected payload bytes.

required_metadata_change.explanation: The requested v2 version tag is the sole metadata exception; literally allowing only text and notes would conflict with the explicit version requirement.
